channel.dingtalk.desc: Push messages to a DingTalk group robot, with optional signing and @all
channel.dingtalk.field.url.desc: Full robot webhook address; it has to carry a non-empty access_token and supports a template
channel.dingtalk.field.secret.desc: Signing secret starting with SEC; the request is not signed when it is left empty
channel.dingtalk.field.msgType.desc: Message type, text (default) or markdown, compared without regard to case
channel.dingtalk.field.atAll.desc: Mention everyone; it applies to a text message alone and markdown refuses it
channel.dingtalk.error.missing_access_to: the DingTalk webhook url carries no access_token value
channel.dingtalk.error.invalid_url: {{.URL}} is not a valid webhook address
channel.dingtalk.error.invalid_msg_type: {{.Type}} is not a valid msgType, want text or markdown
channel.dingtalk.error.empty_content: title and body are both empty
channel.dingtalk.error.empty_markdown_bo: a markdown message needs a body, so pass one with --body
channel.dingtalk.error.at_all_markdown: atAll is not allowed with msgType markdown, use msgType text instead
channel.dingtalk.error.api_code: the platform rejected the request with code {{.Code}}: {{.Message}}
channel.dingtalk.error.bad_response: the DingTalk response could not be read: {{.Detail}}
channel.dingtalk.warn.truncated: message content was cut at the {{.Limit}} byte limit
